# Based

> Based is a crypto trading and spending platform built on Hyperliquid. Trade spot and perpetual futures with self-custody, and spend crypto at 70+ million merchants worldwide with a Visa card.

## Products

- [Cards](https://based.one/cards): Crypto Visa debit cards for spending crypto from Solana, Arbitrum, and Polygon at 70+ million merchants in 160+ countries.
- [Gold+ Card](https://based.one/gold): Premium card with zero FX fees, higher spending limits, airport lounge access, and 24/7 concierge.
- [Trading](https://based.one): Trade spot and perpetual futures on Hyperliquid with sub-second execution, deep liquidity, and full self-custody.
- [BasedCloud](https://based.one/cloud): Spin up your own Hyperliquid trading frontends (web, mobile, desktop, Telegram) with a click.
- [Affiliate Program](https://based.one/affiliate): Three-tiered affiliate system that supercharges Hyperliquid referral fees by 28x.
